description.value: Kobe Japanese Steakhouse is a long-running teppanyaki-style restaurant in Vancouver's West End, billing itself as 'a party at every table' — a nod to the theatrical tableside cooking style. Located on Alberni Street near the Coal Harbour waterfront, it occupies a standalone building and draws both locals and visitors for Japanese cuisine in a lively setting. A touring cyclist finishing a ride in downtown Vancouver would find a sit-down dinner destination within easy reach of the seawall.
